title.value: The Curious Case of Absolute Position Embeddings
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly provided at the beginning of the document.
title.quote: The Curious Case of Absolute Position Embeddings

extractions.description: This paper investigates the reliance of Transformer language models on absolute position embeddings (APEs) and their impact on different natural language processing tasks. It examines how APEs influence sentence encoding in different contexts and evaluates the adequacy of APEs in capturing relative position information of words within sentences.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of language models and position embeddings rather than directly addressing climate or ecological sustainable development issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Our work aims to raise awareness about issues with APEs, which are still widely used in pre-training large language models.
